note: v1, FIRST DRAFT, 'The Weather Indoors' (5:38, 168 bars, 120 bpm with a ritardando to 112 over the last 16 bars, handing the closer its tempo): BUTTERFLY HOUSE. The Lorenz attractor (sigma 10, rho 28, beta 8/3), integrated per sixteenth from one fixed seed, steers every dial: x picks the LOBE - the harmonic world, C# or F# - and the wavetable lead's position (a lane); y picks the lead's partial and how often a TRANCE GATE opens on the pads (a muted ghost track the attractor writes, keyed into a gate); z fires sampled vocal CHOPS (the chopper) near the top of the attractor. The orbit flips lobes 25 times, unpredictably - the song changes key when the weather does; measured on the soloed bass: 68.0 Hz (C#2) in C#-lobe bars, 92.0 Hz (F#2) in F#-lobe bars. TUNING: the HARMONIC SERIES - every pitch a partial (8-16) of the lobe's fundamental, as fractional MIDI (the 7th, 11th and 13th partials alien and pure). DYNAMICS SHOWCASE: the bass PUMPS on the kick, the pads are GATED (and OTT'd), a TRANSIENT shaper on the kick, OTT on the hats, GLUE on the master; a PITCH harmonizer a pure fifth above the wavetable lead. The outro is held in the F# lobe for its last 16 bars, into the closer's F#. Seeds 0/11: 90.56 / 90.56 (cohesion 81, spectrum 87, flow 56 - next); levels clean (-11.0 LUFS, TP -1.29, runs 2); render ~0.23x real time. Engine note: gate's sidechain is 'key=', not 'by='.
